{{Quote|Deploy the super tanks&mdash;attack formation.|TX-21|<ref name="WF" />}}
The '''Separatist super-tank prototype''', or simply '''super tank''', was an experimental tank created by [[Baktoid Armor Workshop/Legends|Baktoid Armor Workshop]]. Commissioned by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems.]] During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the super tank was used during the [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Second Battle of Geonosis]]. Additional tanks were [[Mission to Oznek|deployed]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Oznek]].

==Description==
[[File:SuperTanks.png|thumb|left|200px|Super tanks emerge from the Geonosis droid foundry]]
{{Quote|No, the super tanks are not ready. But when they are, the Republic forces will be routed. They have no weapon that can penetrate its heavy armor.|TX-21, to Poggle the Lesser|<ref name="WF" />}}
The super tank was an experimental tank created by [[Baktoid Armor Workshop/Legends|Baktoid Armor Workshop]]. It looked similar to the [[Multi-Troop Transport/Legends|MTT]] which was also made by Baktoid. It was about half the size of the MTT and had its twin blaster cannons located on the same spot as the MTT. The [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsortank]] also had one turret-mounted twin laser cannon located on the outside in the middle of the craft on either side. Concealed under a retractable section of its armor plating were the vehicle's main weapons: a set of twin warhead launchers capable of easily obliterating an [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TE]] [[Walker/Legends|walker]].<ref name="WF" /> It was equipped with [[Ray shield/Legends|ray shielded]] armor and could easily deflect shots from an AT-TE walker and an [[AV-7 Antivehicle Cannon/Legends|AV-7 Antivehicle Cannon]]. The tank had the [[Separatist hex icon/Legends|logo of the CIS]] painted on both sides.<ref name="WF" />

==History==
{{Quote|Looks like the Separatists have a new toy.|Luminara Unduli, about the new tanks|<ref name="WF" />}}
[[File:Barriss_super_tank_standoff.png|thumb|left|200px|Barriss Offee faces off with a super tank in the droid foundry control room]]
This tank was first used in the [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Second Battle of Geonosis]] by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]]. [[TX-21/Legends|TX-21]] advised [[Archduke/Legends|Archduke]] [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser]] to use the tanks against the advancing [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|army]]. Poggle agreed and 20 tanks were deployed onto the battlefield. The Republic's [[AV-7 Antivehicle Cannon/Legends|AV-7 Cannons]] opened fire on the advancing Tanks, but even after many direct hits, the tanks kept advancing, and then launched a barrage of Mortar rounds, destroying the cannons, and the [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TE]] reinforcements.

The tanks were only destroyed when the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] placed explosives underneath the bridge the tanks were crossing and detonated them.

Another super tank was used inside of the factory as well. Facing it were the Jedi Padawans [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]]. Offee managed to get inside the tank by using her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to cut a hole next to the exposed warhead launcher, and destroying the two droids driving the tank. Tano and Offee were able use the tank's weaponry to destroy the factory from the inside and were saved from the ensuing explosion by the tank's heavy armor.<ref name="WF" />

At another point in the war, at least three super tanks were [[Mission to Oznek|deployed]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Oznek]], which had claimed neutrality but was the site of a Republic [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Mission to Oznek|mission]].<ref name="The Enemy">''[[The Clone Wars: The Enemy Within]]''</ref>
